name: genetic-assembly
description: Native Rust NSGA-II local optimization companion

scripts.setup: npm --prefix sdk ci && npm --prefix sdk run build && npm --prefix inspector ci && npm --prefix cli ci && npm --prefix client ci && npm --prefix visualizations ci
scripts.test: npm run test:study && cargo test --workspace && npm run cli:build && npm --prefix client test && npm run viz:type-check && npm run viz:test && npm run test:python && node scripts/test-wasm.mjs
scripts.docs:dev: npm run build:packages && npm run examples:build && npm --prefix tools/docs run dev
scripts.docs:api: npm run build:packages && npm --prefix tools/docs run generate
scripts.docs:build: npm run build:packages && npm run examples:build && npm --prefix tools/docs run build
scripts.docs:test: npm run docs:build && npm --prefix tools/docs test && npm run test:inspector
scripts.test:study: npm --prefix sdk run build && node --test sdk/tests/*.mjs
scripts.test:inspector: npm --prefix inspector run build && node tools/docs/tests/inspector.mjs

author: nikodellic
